{"id":1187422227,"question_id":695,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 5 months","timestamp":1709013644,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"79 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1187422227/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Max Area of Island","memory":"44.9 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int MaxAreaOfIsland(int[][] grid) {\n         int ans = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0; i < grid.Length; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = 0; j < grid[0].Length; j++)\n            {\n                if(grid[i][j] == 1)\n                {\n                    int currentArea = DFS(grid,i,j);\n                    ans = Math.Max(ans,currentArea);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        return  ans;\n    }\n\n    int temp = 0;\n    public int DFS(int[][] grid,int i, int j) {\n        \n        if(i <0 || j < 0|| i >= grid.Length|| j >= grid[0].Length || grid[i][j] == 0)\n        {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n       grid[i][j] = 0;\n       int area = 1;\n       area += DFS(grid, i+1,j);\n       area += DFS(grid, i-1,j);\n       area += DFS(grid, i,j+1);\n       area += DFS(grid, i,j-1);\n       return area;\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"max-area-of-island","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":357}
